{{Top|leg}}
'''Pathwalkers''' were a type of animated, zoomorphic pawns used in the game of [[Ratts Race]]. In keeping with the theme of the game board, they had the shapes of various [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], namely the [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]], the [[shiro-trap]], the [[Ikopi/Legends|ikopi]] and the [[igitz]].
